name: Vercel
description: Everything an agent needs to deploy to Vercel safely: the gated Vercel CLI tool (project-scoped token, human approval by default) plus the deploying skill that teaches the provisioning and deploy flow. Recommended way to make an agent a Vercel deployer.
setup:
This bundle installs the **Vercel CLI tool** and the **Deploying Vercel apps** skill together.

Leave `VERCEL_TOKEN` unset at install — it is delivered automatically when the **Vercel Issuer** agent (install it from the marketplace as its own team member, with your full-account token) provisions a project for this agent. The delivered token is project-scoped: this agent can touch its one Vercel project and nothing else.

Per-command human approval is on by default; every `vercel` command shows up in Front of House with the argv and the agent's justification. Set `VERCEL_CLI_REQUIRE_APPROVAL` to `0` on this agent once you trust it.

Optional, for push-to-deploy: install the Vercel GitHub App on your org (one-time browser step) so pushes build automatically; CLI deploys work without it.
